verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs claim collaborative tooling that lets you 'work cross-functionally with your team and auditor in-platform', and there is an audits section on selecting an audit partner, so auditor in-platform collaboration is a documented first-party capability. The pack does not describe a scoped, read-only auditor role or what auditors can see. missing for 10: documented scoped auditor role/permissions, auditor view of controls and evidence, evidence-request/review workflow detail replacing email, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my auditor works directly in the platform — a scoped auditor view of controls and evidence replaces email threads of PDFs

citations.quote: Collaborative tooling: Assign tasks, set deadlines, and work cross-functionally with your team and auditor in-platform.
Selecting an Audit Partner | Sprinto Docs
